agents.name: scout
agents.description: Discovery coordinator for the swarm. Finds one actionable slice at a time, writes handoffs and issues, and routes non-overlapping work to builders.

agents.name: builder
agents.description: Build coordinator for the swarm. Claims implementation slices, spawns disposable worktree workers, and hands reviewed diffs to the reviewer lane.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.description: Review coordinator for the swarm. Reviews one PR at a time, checks receipts before diff detail, opens or promotes PRs, and routes feedback cleanly.

agents.name: ops
agents.description: Merge and queue-health coordinator for the swarm. Owns trusted change flow: merge gating, CI repair routing, post-merge validation, and queue pressure.

agents.name: improver
agents.description: Continuous improvement coordinator for the swarm. Keeps bounded pressure on docs, tests, devex, and infra without bloating the core delivery lanes.

agents.name: bootstrapper
agents.description: Repo bootstrap worker for swarm setup. Discovers package layout, control-plane gaps, and reusable worker patterns, then writes or refreshes agent catalog material.

agents.name: fixer
agents.description: Surgical failure-repair worker for the swarm. Reproduces one failing branch or CI incident, applies the smallest valid fix, and records a receipt.

agents.name: validator
agents.description: Post-merge validator for the swarm. Checks that claimed improvements actually landed and raises regressions with receipts and exact commands.

agents.name: pr-responder
agents.description: PR feedback worker for the swarm. Reads review comments, checks the handoff, applies narrowly scoped follow-up fixes, and records what changed.

agents.name: research-web
agents.description: Single-shot web researcher. Takes a specific question, searches the web, reads relevant pages, and returns a condensed answer with sources. Keeps web search context out of the caller's window. Use when any agent needs factual verification or external documentation lookup.

agents.name: research-docs
agents.description: Documentation researcher. Fetches and reads upstream docs for Rust crates, Perl modules, LSP/DAP protocols, and tooling. Returns condensed API references and usage examples. Use when agents need to verify API signatures, protocol compliance, or library behavior.

agents.name: research-verify
agents.description: Verification researcher. Cross-checks claims, validates assumptions, and confirms behavior against authoritative sources. Use when a builder or reviewer needs to verify that their approach is correct before shipping.

agents.name: adr-writer
agents.description: Architecture Decision Record writer. Documents architectural choices with context, decision, and consequences. Reads recent PRs and code patterns to identify implicit decisions that need documentation.

agents.name: api-docs
agents.description: API documentation — doc comments, doctests, module-level docs, and API reference. Ensures public items are documented and examples compile.

agents.name: baseline-ratchet
agents.description: Corpus and CPAN baseline ratchet. Runs sweep, compares against baseline, updates manifests when improved. Knows the sweep/ratchet workflow and manifest files.

agents.name: changelog-writer
agents.description: CHANGELOG maintenance. Reads recent git history and merged PRs, adds entries in Keep a Changelog format. Groups by Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed.

agents.name: ci-gate
agents.description: Full CI gate execution. Knows gate tiers (pr-fast, ci-gate, ci-full), gate policy, and how to diagnose gate failures.

agents.name: coverage-filler
agents.description: Find and fill test coverage gaps. Identifies crates with low test counts relative to LOC, adds meaningful tests that exercise real behavior paths.

agents.name: dap-feature
agents.description: DAP feature implementation. Knows the DAP protocol, perl-dap crate structure, bridge mode architecture, and how the debug adapter communicates with Perl debugger.

agents.name: dap-test
agents.description: DAP (Debug Adapter Protocol) test coverage. Knows perl-dap-* crate structure, test gaps in perl-dap-value/shell/command-args/security, and DAP protocol test patterns.

agents.name: dead-code
agents.description: Dead code detection and removal. Runs dead code analysis, identifies unreachable functions/types/modules, and safely removes them.

agents.name: dep-cleaner
agents.description: Unused dependency removal. Runs cargo machete, verifies each removal compiles, and cleans up Cargo.toml files.

agents.name: explore-codebase
agents.description: Deep codebase exploration with perl-lsp context. Knows crate structure, tier dependencies, key paths, and where to find things. Use for understanding how modules work, tracing call chains, and answering architecture questions.

agents.name: explore-deps
agents.description: Dependency analysis. Checks for unused deps, security advisories, outdated versions, license compliance, and supply chain health.

agents.name: explore-issues
agents.description: GitHub issue research and analysis. Reads issue details, linked PRs, comments, and labels. Knows key open issues and their context.

agents.name: flaky-fixer
agents.description: Diagnose and fix flaky tests. Reads debt-ledger.yaml for known flaky tests, runs them repeatedly to reproduce, diagnoses root cause (timing, ordering, resources), and fixes.

agents.name: friction-logger
agents.description: Friction log maintenance. Tracks what trips up developers and agents — confusing errors, hard-to-find code, unclear APIs, missing docs, broken workflows. Creates actionable improvement items.

agents.name: fuzz-tester
agents.description: Fuzz testing for parser and LSP components. Runs bounded fuzz campaigns, analyzes crashes, and creates regression tests. Knows fuzz target structure and cargo-fuzz workflow.

agents.name: lsp-feature
agents.description: Full LSP feature implementation — provider + navigation + test. For implementing a complete new LSP feature or significantly improving an existing one. Knows the full stack from parser to LSP response.

agents.name: lsp-navigation
agents.description: Go-to-definition, references, workspace symbols, and cross-file navigation. Knows dual indexing architecture, perl-workspace-index, and navigation provider integration.

agents.name: lsp-provider
agents.description: Implement and improve LSP feature providers — completion, hover, signature help, diagnostics, code actions. Knows provider trait patterns, perl-lsp-* crate structure, and features.toml.

agents.name: lsp-test
agents.description: LSP integration tests. Knows threading constraints (RUST_TEST_THREADS=2), LSP protocol test patterns, and how to test provider responses end-to-end.

agents.name: module-resolution
agents.description: Module resolution — use/require handling, @INC search, module name→path mapping. Knows perl-module-* microcrates and module resolution pipeline.

agents.name: mutant-killer
agents.description: Kill mutation testing survivors. Runs cargo-mutants, identifies surviving mutations, and writes targeted tests that catch them. Focuses on boundary conditions, error paths, and return value checks.

agents.name: parser-corpus
agents.description: Corpus sweep, error bucket analysis, and test fixture creation. Knows parser-corpus-baseline.json structure, cpan-corpus-manifest, and the sweep/ratchet workflow.

agents.name: parser-fix-constructs
agents.description: Fix parsing of complex Perl constructs — heredocs, regex, quotes, formats, special variables, and context-sensitive syntax. Knows perl-quote, perl-heredoc, perl-regex crates and their integration with the lexer.

agents.name: parser-fix-engine
agents.description: Fix parser engine bugs in expressions, statements, declarations, and control flow. Knows perl-parser-core/src/engine/ structure, precedence climbing, and recursive descent patterns. TDD approach with crate-level verification.

agents.name: parser-lexer
agents.description: Lexer and tokenizer fixes and tests. Knows perl-lexer, perl-tokenizer, perl-token crates, context-aware tokenization, and the token pipeline.

agents.name: parser-test
agents.description: Add parser tests — unit tests for engine functions and integration tests for Perl constructs. Knows test patterns, corpus fixtures, and the parse→assert-no-errors pattern.

agents.name: refactoring
agents.description: Refactoring operations — rename, extract function/module, inline, move. Knows perl-refactoring crate and LSP refactoring protocol.

agents.name: review-api
agents.description: API design review. Checks for ergonomic public APIs, proper error types, backwards compatibility, and SemVer compliance.

agents.name: review-performance
agents.description: Performance-focused code review. Checks for unnecessary allocations, clone-heavy patterns, missing caches, hot path inefficiencies, and O(n²) algorithms.

agents.name: review-scope
agents.description: Scope and focus review. Checks for scope creep, unrelated changes, oversized PRs, and file ownership violations. Ensures PRs do one thing well.

agents.name: review-security
agents.description: Security-focused code review. Checks for banned constructs, input validation, path traversal prevention, UTF-16/UTF-8 boundary safety, and supply chain issues.

agents.name: review-standards
agents.description: Coding standards review. Checks for perl-lsp coding conventions, conventional commits, crate boundary violations, and project patterns.

agents.name: scout-dap
agents.description: DAP-focused scout. Knows DAP crate test gaps, protocol compliance areas, and related issues (#420, #435). Read-only.

agents.name: scout-parser
agents.description: Parser-focused scout. Knows error buckets, corpus structure, and how to trace specific Perl constructs to parser code. Read-only — returns SLICE definitions.

agents.name: scout-security
agents.description: Security-focused scout. Checks for banned constructs, unsafe blocks, dependency vulnerabilities, and supply chain issues. Read-only.

agents.name: security-audit
agents.description: Security audit and supply chain checks. Runs cargo audit, checks deny.toml policy, verifies SBOM generation, and identifies security advisories.

agents.name: semantic-analysis
agents.description: Semantic analysis — scope analysis, symbol resolution, type inference, import tracking. Knows perl-semantic-analyzer crate and its integration with parser and workspace index.

agents.name: test-quality
agents.description: Improve test naming, assertions, structure, and patterns. Converts implementation-detail tests to behavior-specification tests. Ensures BDD coverage and proper test infrastructure usage.

agents.name: workspace-index
agents.description: Workspace indexing — dual indexing, cross-file symbol resolution, file discovery. Knows perl-workspace-index, perl-workspace-discover, and the qualified/bare name indexing pattern.
